snippet.title: Trailer Cheminots - wishlist on steam
snippet.description:
Cheminots is a train conducting simulator, together you need to make sure the passengers reach their destination. Manage your coal and your water. Keep your locomotive intact. Control your passengers and keep their satisfaction high.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4899300/Cheminots/
